summary: Verify AnyList initial list-settings writes with the exact Android handler.

evidence.result: A disposable list's settings record appeared on fresh GetUserData read-back. AnyList normalized the submitted fields and supplied category-group IDs; remove-list-settings then cleared the record.
evidence.cleanup: The disposable list and settings were removed; cache was refreshed.

validated_outcome: Initial settings creation is evidence-backed; arbitrary general settings updates still require handler-specific probes.
